title: Configuration encoding bit positions
statement: For a finite-state Turing machine $M$ and natural numbers $n$ and $s$, the bit positions are tagged as one of the following: an input coordinate among $n$ coordinates; an input-head coordinate among $n+2$ coordinates; a state choice, including the halting choice; a work-tape coordinate consisting of a tape, one of $2s+1$ cells, and one of three slots; or one of two output-summary coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
